body:
Your AI Twin

Your Intelligent Partner,
Always Learning

An AI that understands your work, adapts to your style, and helps you get more done—while you stay in complete control.

What Is Your Twin?

Your Personal AI Assistant

Your Twin is an AI that learns how you work—your preferences, patterns, and priorities. It helps draft emails, find information, and suggest next steps, all within boundaries you control.

Learns Your Style

Adapts to how you communicate and make decisions.

Works Within Your Data

Only accesses information you've connected and approved.

You Always Approve

Nothing happens without your say-so.

Truth You Own. AI You Rent.

Swappable Intelligence

Your Twin treats AI as a replaceable reasoning engine—not a permanent fixture. Your memory stays yours, while the AI gets smarter over time.

Separation of Memory & Logic

The AI provides reasoning power, but your memory lives separately. The model watches your data and proposes actions—it doesn't own your truth.

Model-Agnostic Architecture

Today it's UX Pilot, tomorrow it could be GPT or Gemini. Swap AI models seamlessly without losing context or rewriting your data.

No Vendor Lock-In

Any AI reads from the same verified knowledge base. Switch providers without losing your accumulated history or context.

Your Moat is Your Memory

As AI models commoditize, the reasoning engine itself isn't your competitive advantage. Your durable asset is the Adaptive Spine—the proprietary approval graph that compounds over time.

  • Generic AI trains on the internet. Your memory is shaped by your team's specific judgments.
  • When the model improves, your system instantly gets smarter without migrating your truth.
  • The rented model gets cheaper and faster. Your owned Spine gets continuously stronger.

Models Change

UX Pilot → GPT → Gemini → Next Gen

Your Memory Stays Constant

Adaptive Spine • Approval Graph • Your Truth

What Your Twin Can Do

Everyday Assistance

From writing emails to finding answers, your Twin handles routine work so you can focus on what matters.

Draft Messages

Compose emails and replies in your voice, using context from your conversations.

Example: "Draft a follow-up to Sarah about the budget discussion."

Surface Insights

Spot patterns and trends across your data to help you make better decisions.

Example: "What themes are coming up in customer feedback?"

Organize Tasks

Sort your to-dos by priority and suggest what to tackle next.

Example: "What should I focus on this week?"

Find Information

Search across all your tools to answer questions instantly.

Example: "What did we decide in last week's planning meeting?"

Summarize Content

Turn long documents and threads into clear, actionable summaries.

Example: "Summarize this 20-page report for the team."

Suggest Responses

Offer reply options based on your past conversations and context.

Example: "How should I respond to this customer question?"
Clear Boundaries

What Your Twin Won't Do

Your Twin operates within strict limits to keep you in control and your data secure.

No Actions Without Permission

  • Send emails or messages automatically
  • Make decisions on your behalf
  • Change or delete your data
  • Share information externally

Strict Data Privacy

  • Access data you haven't connected
  • Learn from other users' information
  • Store data outside your workspace
  • Work when you're not actively using it

You're Always in Charge

Every suggestion requires your approval. You can review, edit, or decline any recommendation. Your Twin learns from your feedback but never acts independently.

Trust & Transparency

Full Visibility

See exactly what your Twin is doing, why it made a suggestion, and what data it used.

Activity Log

Every action is recorded with timestamps and reasoning.

  • What was accessed
  • When and why
  • Full history

Clear Reasoning

Understand how your Twin reached its conclusions.

  • Explanation for suggestions
  • Source citations
  • Confidence levels

Private Workspace

Your Twin works only within your secure environment.

  • Isolated data
  • Encrypted processing
  • Enterprise security
See It In Action

Real Examples

How your Twin helps with everyday work—from drafts to insights.

"Help me prep for tomorrow's meeting with the product team."

Based on your calendar and recent Slack messages, here's a summary:

  • • Agenda: Q2 roadmap review
  • • Key topics: Feature priorities, timeline
  • • Your action items from last meeting: Launch date proposal

Sources: Calendar, Slack #product, Meeting notes from Jan 15

"Draft a response to this customer asking about renewal pricing."

Here's a draft in your style:

"Hi [Name], thanks for reaching out! I'd be happy to discuss renewal options. Based on your current plan, here are a few paths we can explore..."

"What trends are you seeing in support tickets this month?"

I analyzed 247 tickets from January. Top themes:

  • • Login issues (32% increase vs. Dec)
  • • Integration questions (steady)
  • • Feature requests for mobile app (trending up)

Confidence: High | Sources: Zendesk tickets, Jan 1-31

Your Approval Required

How Approvals Work

Every output requires your explicit approval before anything happens.

1. Review

See the suggestion with full context and reasoning.

2. Edit (Optional)

Make changes or request a different approach.

3. Approve

Give the go-ahead, and only then does it proceed.

You Can Always Say No

Decline any suggestion without consequence. Your Twin learns from your feedback and improves over time, but it never pressures you or acts without permission.

  • Reject and move on
  • Request alternative options
  • Provide feedback to improve future suggestions
Data Boundaries

Your Data, Your Rules

Your Twin only works with data you've explicitly connected and approved.

Private Workspace

Your Twin operates only within your workspace boundaries—never accessing data outside your permissions.

No Cross-User Learning

Your Twin learns only from your data. It never trains on or accesses other users' information.

You Control Retention

Delete your Twin's memory anytime. All data is removed permanently from the system.

Full Auditability

Complete Transparency

Every interaction is logged and auditable—you always know what happened and why.

Activity Timeline

See a complete record of your Twin's actions, suggestions, and data access.

Data Query
Today, 2:34 PM

Searched across Slack, Email, and CRM for customer renewal data

Sources: 12 messages, 3 emails, 1 CRM record

Draft Created
Today, 11:15 AM

Generated email response using your previous replies as style reference

Status: Approved and sent

Insight Generated
Yesterday, 4:22 PM

Analyzed support tickets and identified trending issue

Confidence: 87% | Data points: 156 tickets
